description: State Motor Fuel Tax Receipts (MF-201) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration, Office of Highway Policy Information. Annual adjusted net total State motor fuel tax receipts from the Highway Statistics Series table MF-210. The data source is Table MF-1. Increases in 2011 and 2012 were due in large part to a change in California's method of taxing fuel. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 2 columns, among them Receipts, Year. The portal shows 2026-01-14 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Administration, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
